criteria.text: Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 1 September 2029 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 1 September 2031 (48 months after Closing).
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.2 is stated as $10,125,000 but 25% of the $45,000,000 Purchase Price is $11,250,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (25% x $45,000,000 = $11,250,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $10,125,000.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (1 September 2029; 1 September 2031) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 23 June 2027 (801 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
